standard_prerequisites.name: The locally-given situation and the negative-ext assumption
standard_prerequisites.use: Statement lines 5589-5592: negative self-exts of E_U in D(O_{u(U)}) are zero; L is a simplicial object of SR(B) with K = u(L).

standard_prerequisites.name: The ringed total site of the augmentation
standard_prerequisites.use: Statement lines 5593-5596: ((C/K)_total, O) is the ringed total site of the remark, with component ringed topoi O_n on C/K_n = C/u(L_n).

standard_prerequisites.name: The product decomposition of semi-representable topoi
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 5602-5607: Sh(C/K_n) = prod Sh(C/u(U_{n,i})) and similarly for modules and derived categories, compatibly with the morphisms of the simplicial object K.

standard_prerequisites.name: Cartesian derived objects from simplicial systems, and uniqueness
standard_prerequisites.use: Proof lines 5615-5627: the simplicial system with Hom(E_n[t], E_n) = 0 for t > 0 produces the cartesian object E; uniqueness up to unique isomorphism follows from the nullity and Hom lemmas.

core_obligations: The product decomposition (proof lines 5602-5607): Sh(C/K_n) = prod_{i in I_n} Sh(C/u(U_{n,i})), inherited by the categories of modules and by the derived categories, and compatible with the morphisms of the simplicial semi-representable object K.

The simplicial system (lines 5607-5614): set E_n = prod_{i in I_n} E_{U_{n,i}} (the author's 'formal' product) in D(O_n); taking formal products of the maps rho_a of the situation gives isomorphisms E_phi : f_phi^* E_n -> E_m, and the assumed composition relations immediately make (E_n, E_phi) a simplicial system of the derived category of modules as in definition-cartesian-derived-modules.

Existence and uniqueness (lines 5614-5627): the vanishing of negative self-exts gives Hom(E_n[t], E_n) = 0 for n >= 0 and t > 0; the cartesian-derived-from-simplicial lemma produces the cartesian object E whose restriction to D(O_{C/u(U_{n,i})}) is E_{U_{n,i}} compatibly; uniqueness up to unique isomorphism follows from the nullity and Hom lemmas for cartesian modules.
proof_roadmap: Decompose the component topoi as products over the objects of the semi-representable covering.
Assemble the simplicial system (E_n, E_phi) from formal products and the maps rho_a.
Conclude existence from the cartesian-derived-from-simplicial lemma and uniqueness from the nullity and Hom lemmas.
difficulty_reason: Existence/uniqueness lemma (statement 5587-5600, proof 5602-5627): glues the objects E_U along the simplicial semi-representable object via formal products and the maps rho_a - the simplicial-system condition follows immediately from the assumed composition relations, existence from the chapter's cartesian-derived-from-simplicial lemma under the negative-ext vanishing, and uniqueness from the nullity and Hom lemmas; no verification is omitted. H2: glueing assembled from established derived-category lemmas.
